narrative.headline: 2018 Subaru Outback: electrical and mirror complaints lead the list
narrative.summary: Owners filed 800 complaints with NHTSA. The electrical system is the most reported area at 33%, followed closely by visibility/wiper issues at 29%. No deaths are reported, and serious outcomes are rare. The fuel/propulsion system draws far fewer complaints (5%) but accounts for the most crashes (3) and the only reported injury, so it is worth a close look on a test drive.
